children: may revisit its previous trading session's high of $3.0025 per lb, as a bounce from $2.8660 looks incomplete.
The bounce may consist of three waves. The third wave, the upward wave c, could develop around the current level of $2.9115, as indicated by a short rising trendline.
This wave is capable of travelling the peak of the wave a at $3.0025. Support is at $2.8755, a break below which may trigger a fall into $2.7835-$2.8755 range.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
